name: How long does a bathroom remodel take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom remodel take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom remodel depends on its complexity. A minor cosmetic update might be completed within 1-2 weeks. A mid-range renovation, involving demolition, new plumbing, electrical work, and new installations, typically takes 3-5 weeks. A major remodel with layout changes or structural work could extend to 6-8 weeks or more. These timelines include planning, material selection, demolition, and all installation phases. Unexpected issues can sometimes prolong the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A bathroom remodel can take from 1-2 weeks for minor updates to 6-8 weeks or more for major renovations, depending on complexity.
